constraints.name: entitlement_definition_kind_type
constraints.definition: CHECK (kind = 'feature'::text AND value_type = 'boolean'::text OR kind = 'limit'::text AND (value_type = ANY (ARRAY['integer'::text, 'decimal'::text])))

constraints.name: exchange_orders_pricing_rule_id_tenant_id_pricing_rules_id_tena
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (pricing_rule_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES pricing_rules(id, tenant_id)

constraints.name: global_exchange_catalog_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (kind <> 'currencies'::text OR id = code AND code ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text AND (code <> ALL (ARRAY['DZD'::text, 'ILS'::text])))

constraints.name: global_exchange_catalog_links_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (NOT verified OR kind <> 'asset_network'::text OR COALESCE((metadata ->> 'native'::text) = 'true'::text, false) OR COALESCE(length(metadata ->> 'contractAddress'::text) > 0, false))

constraints.name: global_exchange_catalog_links_source_kind_source_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_kind, source_id) REFERENCES global_exchange_catalog(kind, id)

constraints.name: global_exchange_catalog_links_target_kind_target_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (target_kind, target_id) REFERENCES global_exchange_catalog(kind, id)

constraints.name: landing_products_amounts
constraints.definition: CHECK ((starting_price IS NULL OR starting_price >= 0::numeric) AND (setup_fee IS NULL OR setup_fee >= 0::numeric))

constraints.name: landing_products_copy
constraints.definition: CHECK (length(btrim(name)) >= 2 AND length(btrim(name)) <= 100 AND length(btrim(description)) >= 10 AND length(btrim(description)) <= 500 AND length(btrim(cta_label)) >= 2 AND length(btrim(cta_label)) <= 40)

constraints.name: plans_nonnegative_metadata
constraints.definition: CHECK (monthly_price >= 0::numeric AND yearly_price >= 0::numeric AND setup_fee >= 0::numeric AND display_order >= 0)

constraints.name: wallet_configurations_tenant_id_asset_network_id_tenant_asset_n
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, asset_network_id) REFERENCES tenant_asset_networks(tenant_id, asset_network_id)

constraints.name: white_label_attachments_request_id_white_label_requests_id_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES white_label_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: white_label_events_request_id_white_label_requests_id_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES white_label_requests(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: white_label_request_delivery_requires_tenant
constraints.definition: CHECK (status <> 'delivered'::text OR tenant_id IS NOT NULL)
